original.subject: Urgent: Compromised Vendor Account — pumplink-support
original.body:
This is a critical alert from the PumpLink Security Operations Center. The account pumplink-support was used to access a hospital's infusion pump server (ORRMC-PUMP01) via the session broker ORRMC-VSB01 on 2026-03-12 at 13:48. The attacker changed the drug library to version 4.2.2, which disables safety alarms for high-dose infusions. The same session scanned the device network 10.40.x.x and triggered device communication anomalies.

The account was compromised in a third-party breach of our vendor portal on 2026-03-09. We have disabled the account and are conducting a forensic review. We recommend that all users of our systems immediately disable remote access, enable signed library verification, and report any anomalies to the FDA. This incident has been escalated to the FDA’s Medical Device Cybersecurity Division.

We will provide a secure update package for the pump server and a new session broker configuration within 24 hours. Please preserve all logs, disk images, and network traffic from the session. Do not rebuild the server until you have our signed guidance.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the attacker's method and the vendor's responsibility. The AOC and ISO must decide on long-term remote access policy, including multi-factor authentication and signed library enforcement. Watch for attempts to bypass the vendor's new requirements.
